about_the_game:
UP CARDS is a card game based on playing cards, where you can enjoy endless fun and thrilling excitement through the process of continuous upgrading and advancement.

Getting started with the game is simple; I believe anyone can easily master it. But to reach higher levels, you need to proceed steadily, making experienced decisions and brainstorming-like thinking with every step.

- Combination of multiple different card types, more basic game play upgrades;

- Multiple card effects appear randomly, adding more opportunities and challenges

- Multiple special effects enhance unlocking, allowing players to climb higher levels;

- Multiple upgrade reward options to create your unique gaming style;

The game is still under continuous improvement and updates. If you have any good ideas or suggestions, feel free to contact me.

short_description: UP CARDS is a light roguelike card game. In this exciting journey, you need to control the card situation, play the best combinations, stack additional effects to turn the tide, choose your permanent rewards, and reach new heights through different strategic builds.
